description: Kit image upload and visual enhancements
changes: Added Cloudinary image upload for kit items
Kits now display uploaded images instead of emojis
Added edit functionality to kit management - update name, description, and image
Enhanced kit card design with full-height images on the left
PNG images with transparency blend seamlessly with card backgrounds
Updated Firebase rules to support imageUrl and updatedAt fields
Improved My Kits page visual layout with horizontal card design
Added image preview when uploading/editing kits
